worldcombat.skill.lashout.summary: Vents every bottled-up frustration at the target: the power doubles while any of the user's stats is lowered, and the hit sheds those lowered stages, optionally turning the rage into an Attack boost.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.0: Hit hard right after being weakened
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.1: Shed every stockpiled lowered stage at once
worldcombat.skill.lashout.use.2: Trade rage for an Attack boost
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.0: Deals %1$s physical damage; the power doubles while any of the user's stat stages is negative at impact.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.1: Steps in up to %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks; shoves the target back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.description.2: On a hit, sheds up to %1$s negative levels starting from the lowest stat; with Vent on, converts the rage into %2$s Attack stages for %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.vent.on: Vent on: a hit clears every negative stage at once and converts the rage into 1 to 3 Attack stages (more the deeper the frustration); costs 3 ticks more prepare and 8 ticks more cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.vent.off: Vent off: a hit sheds a single negative level with no boost, at a shorter prepare and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.growth.0: At level %1$s the vented power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.growth.1: At level %1$s the vented power rises to %2$s and the rage boost to %3$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.lashout.preference.ven: On: a hit clears every negative stage at once and converts the rage into 1 to 3 Attack stages (more the deeper the frustration, lasting a few seconds), but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 8 ticks more. Off: a single negative level is shed with no boost, quicker and cheaper.
Only steps in against threats this close; a larger value chases a weakened target further.
On: vents on a target as soon as the user carries a negative stage (exactly the doubling window). Off: sorted like an ordinary melee attack.
